features: Curve Weights: Edit the weights of deformers on Nurbs curves from the Weights menu, including Flood, Smooth, Invert, Mirror, Copy, and Paste, on the whole curve or just the selected CVs.
Flood Curve Gradient: Ramp a curve's weights from 0 to 1 or 1 to 0 along its CVs, so it stays even when the CVs are unevenly spaced.
Settings Overrides: Lock settings for everyone with the new settings_overrides.json. Settings from an older studio_overrides.json carry over automatically.
fixes: Better Mirror: Mirroring weights now catches every vertex on meshes that kept their construction history. It warns instead of hanging when there's nothing to mirror from, and it tells you when a cached mesh is mirrored by its pose on the current frame.
Painting In Maya 2023: Paint Weights now opens properly in Maya 2023.
Safer Map Export: Exporting a map to a folder you can't write to now gives a clear warning.
Centered Settings: Settings rows stay centered when you open a section.
Cleaner Sticky List: Rows are indented less, so long names fit better.

overview: Sticky Mod 2.0.0 is a top-to-bottom overhaul with substantial performance boosts, new features, stability improvements, and a brand new UI. Tested in Maya 2023+, but may be compatible in 2022+. Consider this a beta, since there is much new code, and bugs are likely. Please contact fRigging Awesome Studios via the Help menu if you encounter any issues. Thanks.
features: Sticky List: See, filter, and select every Sticky Mod in the scene, with muted ones grayed out.
Weights Menu: Paint, flood, smooth, invert, mirror, copy, paste, import, and export Sticky Mod weights.
Mirror: Copy Sticky Mods to the other side of the mesh, with their position and painted weights mirrored and their settings carried over.
Copy and Attach: Copy a Sticky Mod onto new vertices on any mesh, or move it to a new vertex, keeping its pose and keys, plus its painted weights on the same mesh.
Mute: Mute the selected Sticky Mods, the ones on the selected meshes, or all of them at once.
Orient and Aim Options: Orient the offset to any object, have it turn with an object, or keep it aimed at the camera.
Colors: Pick colors for each Sticky Mod and its offset.
Update Selected: Give existing Sticky Mods your current color, style, and display settings.
Quick Selecting: Select all Sticky Mods, the meshes they deform, or the Sticky Mods on the selected meshes.
Toggle Visibility: Show or hide every Sticky Mod at once.
Display Layer: Put new Sticky Mods on their own display layer.
Move To Top: Put Sticky Mods back on the surface after adding other deformers to a mesh.
Naming: Rename Sticky Mods with a custom name, a suffix, and cleanup options.
SM1 Compatibility: Convert Sticky Mods between SM1 and SM2, or keep building SM1 ones for older scenes.
Docking: Dock the window to either side of Maya, and it reopens the way you left it.
Settings: Adjust UI scale, fonts, colors, layout, and more.
Tooltips and Help: Every control has a tooltip, and there's a built-in Help section.
Update Alerts: Find out when a new version is out, with its patch notes.
fixes: Better Sticking: Sticky Mods sit more accurately on the surface and hold their orientation better on bent areas like elbows.
Reordering Deformers: Sticky Mods stay on their point when deformers are reordered, and Move To Top fixes any that stop deforming.
